Anker is changing the way its ecosystem is presented at IFA 2026: Anker, eufy, soundcore, SOLIX and eufyMake are coming together under one identity - “Ultimate, Unified.” But does that actually mean anything beyond a new logo?
In this first-person walkthrough of the Anker booth at IFA 2026, we look at what is really changing and put several of the new demonstrations under a little more scrutiny.
We start with soundcore, including the new THUS AI Chip and Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 Pro, then move through Anker’s charging lineup with the Anker MagGo Power Bank Pro 2 and Anker Laptop Charger Pro.
At Anker eufyMake, we create a physical The Q item using the eufyMake UV Printer E1, giving us a chance to judge the finished result for ourselves.
